newsitem.title: UK: Remy, Highland to market drinks in India.
newsitem.headline: Remy, Highland to market drinks in India.

text.p: French drinks group Remy Cointreau and Scotch whisky maker Highland Distilleries Co Plc said they are to start bottling and marketing their drinks in India via a joint venture with an Indian firm.
The joint company will be partners with DCM Shriram, an Indian company which produces sugar and liquor and has a distribution network in northern India, the main whisky drinking area.
Both Remy and Highland see great potential for spirits in India, where liqueurs and white spirits are now the fastest growing alcoholic drinks in northern India and Bombay.
Remy chairman Andre Heriard Dubreuil said in a statement, "India is a large spirits market, with sales of about 50 million cases and is growing by as much as 10 percent a year."
The joint venture company is expected to be up and running by early 1997 and will market brands that will have specific appeal to the Indian market.
